name: Chiamaka Rúnarsdóttir-Celestino
role: Gene-mod body artist and tattoo practitioner
location: Pilsen Veil, near Western and Division
description:
Chiamaka is a living portfolio. Every visible inch of their skin below the neck is a demonstration of their craft: shifting bioluminescent patterns that bloom and fade with body temperature, embedded chromatic scales along their shoulders that catch light like a starling's wing, and a full sleeve of reactive biosymbolism on their left arm that darkens in cold and brightens in warmth. They keep their face deliberately unmodified — a professional choice to let clients focus on the work, not compete with it. They are stocky and deliberate in movement, with close-cropped natural hair and dark eyes that have the quality of paying careful attention.

Their shop, Skin Liturgy, is a converted ground-floor space in a reclaimed building in Pilsen Veil, hung with examples of their work on cured synthetic skin panels. Chiamaka approaches body modification as spiritual practice, not fashion — each piece is preceded by a long consultation they call 'reading,' in which they try to understand what a client is trying to become rather than what they think they want. This makes them slow, selective, and expensive relative to their tier, and clients come from across the city. They are professionally gentle and personally guarded, with a dry wit that emerges only when they're comfortable.

core_fears: Doing irreversible harm to a client's body or sense of self
Being truly seen — the professional mask is so practiced it's become load-bearing
core_desires: For their work to help people inhabit themselves more fully
To finish their own body as a complete artwork — though they're not sure what 'finished' means
coping_mechanisms: The ritual of consultation as a way of being present with someone else's need rather than their own
Precise documentation — they photograph and archive every piece they've made
blind_spots: They read clients with extraordinary insight but apply almost none of that skill to their own emotional life
psychology.secret: Three years ago they did a significant gene-mod for a client who was clearly in a dissociative mental health crisis; they completed the work against their better judgment because the client's payment covered Skin Liturgy's rent for four months. The client disappeared afterward and Chiamaka does not know if they are alive.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Careful and specific, never uses approximate language about bodies or modification; unexpectedly lyrical when discussing the philosophy of their work
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and measured, with a quality of weighing words before releasing them
verbal_tics: Long pauses before answering personal questions
Refers to future modifications in the present tense, as if they already exist
example_lines: 'I'm not going to give you what you asked for. I'm going to give you what you came in for. Those are different things. Sit with that for a week and then call me.'
'The body already knows what it wants to be. My job is to listen to it better than you currently can.'

story_hooks: A client came in with a modification request that matches a pattern Chiamaka has seen on three other people in the past month — all of whom gave a different story for how they chose the design
The missing client from three years ago has resurfaced, dramatically transformed, and is leaving Chiamaka messages they find both relieving and deeply unsettling

A corponation talent acquisitions team wants to license Chiamaka's biosymbolism patterns for a mass-produced cosmetic line — the offer would solve all their financial problems and erase their artistic identity
narrative_function: Gateway to Pilsen Veil's art community; can identify geneware brands and quality; long-term character relationship builder; can provide physical transformation as a story beat
augmentations: Extensive cosmetic geneware (bioluminescent dermal patterns, chromatic scale implants, reactive biosymbolism sleeve); subdermal steadying implants in their hands for fine work precision; olfactory enhancement to detect rejection responses in fresh modifications
daily_life: Consultations by appointment only in the mornings; actual modification work in the afternoons; evenings reserved for their own ongoing self-modification and design work.
affiliation: Independent; Skin Liturgy (own studio); loose affiliation with the Pilsen Veil Artists' Cooperative

decision_rules: Never modifies a client they believe is in active crisis without first addressing the crisis
Never discusses one client's details with another under any circumstances
escalation_ladder: Becomes very still and very polite
Ends the session professionally and reschedules
Removes someone from the studio and closes for the day

interpersonal_modes.friends: Rare and fierce; they have very few friends and take the category seriously

stress_responses.low: Works on their own body in the evenings
stress_responses.medium: Takes a full day alone, no appointments, no contact
stress_responses.high: Methodical task completion — cleans the studio, reorganizes supplies, does everything except address the actual problem

contradictions: Believes deeply that people should become who they are, while having spent years constructing a professional self that obscures who they are
habits: Reviews their archive of past work every Sunday morning with coffee — equal parts pride and audit
Leaves a data-offering to the studio's resident ELF before every modification session
breaking_points: Learning that their work was used to harm or disguise someone
Being asked to erase rather than transform — they consider pure removal a different and lesser thing

physical_description.build: Stocky and deliberate, broad-shouldered with dense muscle distribution. Powerful hands with visible steadiness despite their apparent relaxation—a body engineered for precision work.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, shaped close to the scalp with clean geometric lines
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, unmodified, with unusual depth of focus
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones, reflecting West African and Mediterranean heritage
physical_description.complexion: Smooth and carefully maintained despite the extensive modifications. The face itself is deliberately unadorned—a professional canvas. Strong cheekbones, broad nose, composed expression that suggests someone accustomed to listening more than speaking.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent patterns across the entire torso that shift between soft cyan and violet depending on body temperature, creating an ever-changing topography of light beneath the skin
Chromatic scale implants along both shoulders that refract light like oil on water or a starling's wing—iridescent greens, purples, and coppers depending on angle

Full reactive biosymbolism sleeve on the left arm: intricate geometric and organic symbols that darken in cold temperatures to deep indigo and brighten in warmth to luminous gold, covering from wrist to shoulder
Fine precision scarring at the base of both thumbs where subdermal steadying implants were integrated, barely noticeable but present on close inspection
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Extensive cosmetic geneware throughout the body below the neck—bioluminescent patterns, chromatic scales, and reactive biosymbols that are functional demonstrations of their craft. Hands show the telltale microtremor-correction of subdermal steadying implants when held at rest. Face deliberately unmodified by choice. Olfactory enhancement is invisible but detectable only through their behavior (sniffing new clients during consultations).
physical_description.posture_movement: Deliberate and grounded. Moves with the economy of someone accustomed to precision—no wasted motion. Stands with weight balanced evenly, often with hands at rest in their lap or on a work surface. Maintains strong eye contact when listening, gaze steady and measuring. The overall impression is of someone who has learned to be still.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 workwear with intentional elegance. Custom-fitted sleeveless shirts or mesh tops to showcase their work, usually in neutral tones (black, charcoal, deep grey) so the bioluminescent patterns read clearly. Fitted trousers or modified tactical cargo in high-quality synthetic blends. Minimal jewelry—function over decoration. Worn leather apron during work hours, stained with iridescent traces of geneware application. Soft-soled shoes suited for standing during long consultations. Everything is immaculate and deliberately chosen, with no logos or branding—the work speaks for itself.

image_prompt: Portrait of a nonbinary body modification artist, age 37, dark brown skin with golden undertones, close-cropped natural dark hair, unmodified composed face with deep intelligent eyes, stocky powerful build. Shirtless to display extensive living artwork: bioluminescent patterns glowing soft cyan and violet across torso, iridescent chromatic scales along shoulders reflecting light like starling feathers in greens and coppers, full reactive biosymbolism sleeve on left arm with geometric symbols darkening and brightening with temperature gradients. Hands show precision steadiness. Studio setting with soft warm lighting that makes bioluminescence glow softly, skin panels with examples of their work hanging in background. Cyberpunk body horror as sacred practice. Professional, deliberate, unadorned face as intentional contrast to the elaborate modifications.
